exact_items: Add explicit first-class storage families for runtime-artifact indexing/projection: canonical redb key registration, projector ownership/checkpoint semantics, rebuild/failure semantics, clear schema ownership boundary
Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md declares artifacts_index:v1:{project_id} as canonical, but storage-plan.md does not appear to register/own that family at the same level as other redb families

Proposed artifact-index keys: artifacts_index.v1:{project_id}:{artifact_id} (current lookup/index row), artifacts_project_state.v1:{project_id} (projector cursor/health), projector.checkpoint.runtime_artifacts:{project_id} (projector checkpoint)
notes: The index is a projection for lookup/filter/navigation; must be rebuildable from seglog
Missing/corrupt index rows must degrade to record-backed views rather than implying artifact loss
Minimum indexed fields: artifact_id, artifact_type, project_id, run_id?, thread_id?, node_id?, attempt_id?, created_at_utc, summary, primary refs

exact_items: Add explicit first-class storage families for durable worktree/lane lifecycle: worktree_record, lane_record, worktree_projection, lane_projection

WorktreeGitImprovement.md now expects durable worktree identity, restart recovery, ownership, conflict state, historical lineage, and cross-surface CTAs but storage-plan.md currently has only adjacent state
notes: Minimum worktree_record fields: worktree_id, project_id, repo_id, path_ref, branch_ref, baseline_ref?, created_at_utc, created_by_run_id?, created_by_attempt_id?, lane_id?, historical_lineage_refs[]?

Minimum worktree_projection fields: lifecycle state (active|suspect|restoring|retained|cleanup_eligible|archived|removed), dirty_state, conflict_state, owner_run_id?, owner_attempt_id?, latest blocked_reason_code?, last_seen_at_utc, projection_freshness, projection_health
Source Control being worktree-first in UI does not remove the need for lane lineage in storage

exact_items: storage-plan.md should own: key registration, projector/rebuild semantics, current vs historical projection rules for artifact index and worktree/lane families
WorktreeGitImprovement.md should own: operational behavior, cleanup/archive/remove rules, UI expectations for Source Control and Orchestrator
Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md should own: artifact-type semantics, panel behavior, schema family references
orchestrator.receipt should remain the cross-surface bridge record, not the substitute for worktree or artifact lifecycle records
notes: receipt linkage is necessary but not sufficient; it cannot carry the full weight of lifecycle/history/state projection

exact_items: Audit storage-plan.md for other downstream-assumed families already discussed in research: project summary / attention items, concern records/projections, account pressure and switch history, projection freshness/health fields on projections
The storage gap is now about concrete missing object families, not just incomplete wording
Current storage families are still more attempt/block/usage-centric than lane/worktree/concern/project-attention-centric, even though the rewrite now relies on those object families elsewhere

Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md three-way ownership contradiction with Contracts_V0.md and storage-plan.md over payload schema authority; still points at missing schema files
Resolve the payload-owner triangle for runtime artifacts and either add the missing schema family/registration or soften the mandate explicitly
